title: Tangent coordinates for nonlinear fine-tuning with linearization audit
hypothesis: A shared low-rank Mirror basis learned from task tangent updates will preserve heldout nonlinear fine-tuning quality with at least 25% fewer complete bytes than independent updates, outperform random intrinsic-dimension projection, and strictly beat native PCA/tangent factorization at matched rank.

world.model: one-hidden-layer tanh MLP (input 6, hidden 12, scalar output)
world.split: six task updates to fit basis, four support-adapted heldout tasks

development.tuning: none; closed-form tangent least squares and rank-4 SVD

fresh.release_rule: Keep fresh sealed after exact native factorization alias or quality/byte gate miss.

controls: exact nonlinear teacher update upper bound
Mirror task coordinates in shared tangent basis

paid_objects: shared tangent basis or random projection

success_gate: At a predeclared delta scale, Mirror must attain nonlinear heldout nRMSE <=0.02, save >=25% complete bytes vs independent updates, beat random rank-4 subspace, and strictly beat native PCA at identical rank.
failure_gate: FAIL if linearization residual exceeds quality tolerance, compression loses quality, random/native control matches Mirror, or byte gate misses.
boundaries: Synthetic tanh MLP only; not a pretrained language model or real PEFT result.
Task updates are constructed from a shared low-rank tangent basis; broader task distributions are untested.
Four heldout task codes are fitted from support data; no zero-shot task generation.
No fresh seeds after native alias or gate miss.

amendment_01.before_amended_run: Added before rerunning the development screen; no fresh or audit worlds were viewed.
amendment_01.reason: The original 96 support examples were fewer than the 97 MLP parameters, making per-task tangent least squares underdetermined.
amendment_01.change: Increase support_examples_per_task from 96 to 256; preserve the same model, seeds, tasks, scales, controls and gates.
